message.content: {"B_expression":"-1/(2*(1+u)*(sqrt((1+u)**2+r)+1+u)**2)","C_expression":"-1/(2*(1+u))","derivation":"Retained from P00_W0. The bodies implement the exact Newton correction for (z+g)^2=p with z=1+u. Setting a=1+u and s=sqrt(a^2+r), the exact step is g_exact=s-a=r/(s+a). The host slot requires r^2*B+u*r*C = g_exact - r/2. Substituting B=-1/(2*a*(s+a)^2) and C=-1/(2*a) gives -r^2/(2a(s+a)^2) - ur/(2a) = -r/(2a)*[r/(s+a)^2+u]. Since r/(s+a)^2=(s-a)/(s+a), this equals -(s-a)/(2a)*[s(1+u)-a(1-u)]/(s+a). With u=a-1 the bracket becomes s*a-a*(2-a)=a(s+a-2), so the whole expression is -(s-a)*(s+a-2)/2=(s-a)(2-s-a)/2=s-a-(s^2-a^2)/2=s-a-r/2. Identity confirmed. Smoothness: a>=3/4 and a^2+r>=1/16 on the outer rectangle |r|<=1/2,|u|<=1/4, so sqrt and divisions are C-infinity on a neighborhood. Numeric feedback: all rows with full chi support show residuals at machine precision (<=2e-71); rows with |r|>=1/2 fall to the linear reference g=r/2 by design; rows with 1/8<|u|<1/4 show the expected attenuated residual from the smooth chi_u transition. No modification needed for the next target stage (p2), which uses the same two-slot structure with updated r,u.","inspect":[{"file_id":"CALC/initial.json","limit":4096,"offset":0}],"note":"Program retained unchanged. Successor checks for stage p2: (1) u carries forward from the p1-updated z, so u will generally be O(tau^2)~O(1e-5) for UNIFORM rows, well inside chi_u support; (2) for edge families (LEFT/RIGHT/BOTH) with large z deviations, |u| may exceed 1/8 and the correction will be attenuated—this is the designed behavior, not a failure; (3) the LEFT x=1/8 s=0 row with r=-1.0 remains outside chi_r support (|r|>=1/2) and uses g=r/2; (4) ZERO family stays at z=1.0 exactly (r=0, u=0, g=0); (5) analytic-domain certificate remains NOT_CERTIFIED; the smoothness argument above is a local algebraic verification on the rectangle neighborhood, not a full PDE estimate."}
